name: Paystack–Xero payment repair
demand: The eligible market is the overlap of Paystack merchants and Xero users in South Africa, Nigeria, and Ghana; that overlap is unverified. Paystack said it served 300,000+ businesses across its markets on 2026-01-20, while Xero reported 426,000 Rest of World customers at 2026-03-31. Neither figure identifies the target-country overlap. The Xero listing shows 6 reviews, not installs or active users. Search volume, installs, connector users, and a relevant regulated population are unverified. Sources: https://prod-blog.paystack.com/blog/company-news/10-years-of-paystack-and-the-beginning-of-the-stack-group ; https://links.sgx.com/FileOpen/Appendix%204E%20and%20FY26%20Annual%20Report.ashx?App=Announcement&FileID=888736 ; https://apps.xero.com/za/app/paystack
prices: The Paystack Xero listing shows no connector subscription price; it is unverified. Paystack's transaction charges, edited 2026-09-15, include Ghana local payments at 1.95%, Nigeria local payments at 1.5% + NGN 100 (capped at NGN 2,000, with the flat fee waived below NGN 2,500), and South Africa local payments at 2.9% + R1 excluding VAT. The closer Paystack-to-Xero competitor KoboSync advertises a free Starter plan and Pro at NGN 10,000/month; this is its published price, not proof of sales. South African adjacent alternatives include Paysoft Flow at R299/month plus negotiated transaction charges, and Peach Payments at 2.95% + R1.50 per transaction on its Growth plan. Sources: https://apps.xero.com/za/app/paystack ; https://support.paystack.com/en/articles/2130306 ; https://www.kobosync.com/ ; https://www.kobosync.com/legal/terms ; https://paysoftflow.co.za/pricing/ ; https://www.peachpayments.com/fees/ ; https://www.peachpayments.com/integrations/xero/

revenue_proof.claim: No verified paying-user count or revenue for the Paystack–Xero connector was found. Xero reported broader payments revenue for FY26 and linked invoice-payment growth to product adoption, but did not attribute it to this connector or these target markets.
Paystack announced group-level profitability; the announcement gives no connector-level revenue, user count, or financial breakdown, so this is weak adjacent evidence only.

copy_speed: The closest dated entrant found is KoboSync: its terms are effective 2026-06-09, its About page says founded in 2026, and its live site markets Paystack-to-Xero transaction syncing. That establishes a relevant competitor by June, not its exact launch date or sales. Paystack itself added gateway response codes in June 2026 and webhook-event history, payload lookup, and resend in September 2026, making reliability alerts easier for the incumbent or another connector to copy. The Paystack Xero app itself dates to April 2022. Sources: https://www.kobosync.com/ ; https://www.kobosync.com/legal/terms ; https://www.kobosync.com/about ; https://paystack.com/docs/changelog/api/ ; https://apps.xero.com/za/app/paystack
platform_risk: High. Paystack owns the existing connector, and its setup guide was edited 2026-09-15; it can fix the reported problems or add alerts itself. Xero requires certification for app partners, including checks for error handling, data integrity, security, and payment mapping, with annual recertification; payment apps need prior approval. Under Xero's current tiering, Starter is free for up to 5 connections but is not App Store eligible; Core is AUD 35/month for 50 connections and also lacks App Store eligibility; Plus is AUD 245/month for up to 1,000 connections, with App Store listing optional. Xero also prohibits using API data to train AI/ML models. Sources: https://support.paystack.com/en/articles/2127426 ; https://developer.xero.com/xero-developer-platform-commercial-terms ; https://developer.xero.com/documentation/xero-app-store/app-partner-guides/building-and-growing-your-app/ ; https://developer.xero.com/pricing ; https://developer.xero.com/faq
defensible_asset: Weak today. There is no apparent UK-specific data advantage because the connector is limited to South Africa, Nigeria, and Ghana. A useful asset could become a tested failure-code and reconciliation ruleset across those markets, with customer-authorised incident history; no such dataset or switching cost is evidenced. Paystack's new webhook-history and resend API further reduces the uniqueness of a standalone alert layer. Sources: https://apps.xero.com/za/app/paystack ; https://paystack.com/docs/changelog/api/ ; https://www.kobosync.com/
build_effort: High for a solo operator if the product actually replaces or repairs payment posting: it needs secure OAuth and API-key handling, event deduplication, retries, invoice/payment mapping, reconciliation, monitoring, and safe exception handling. Xero's certification covers several of those areas and makes the app partner responsible for support and ongoing maintenance. A narrower read-only alert monitor would be less work, but its ability to solve the underlying payment and reconciliation failure is unverified. Exact build duration is unverified. Sources: https://developer.xero.com/xero-developer-platform-commercial-terms ; https://developer.xero.com/documentation/xero-app-store/app-partner-guides/building-and-growing-your-app/ ; https://support.paystack.com/en/articles/2127426
channel: Use inbound discovery through the Xero App Store after approval, Paystack's integration directory, search-focused troubleshooting content, and moderator-approved public posts that invite voluntary opt-in. Do not depend on cold email, SMS, WhatsApp, or social DMs to individuals or sole traders: ICO guidance treats social DMs as electronic mail and says unsolicited electronic marketing to sole traders generally requires consent. Sources: https://developer.xero.com/documentation/xero-app-store/app-partner-guides/building-and-growing-your-app/ ; https://support.paystack.com/en/articles/2128194 ; https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/business-to-business-marketing/
owner_hours_per_week: Unverified; the <=5-hour constraint is not demonstrated. Xero makes the app partner responsible for customer support, onboarding, technical issues, and ongoing maintenance, and requires annual recertification. Agent-run monitoring and first-line triage could reduce routine work, but exception volume and support time are unknown. Source: https://developer.xero.com/xero-developer-platform-commercial-terms
desk_test: Within one day and without building: make a transparent one-page offer for a Paystack–Xero failure-alert pilot, disclose that it is not built, and show KoboSync's published NGN 10,000/month price as a market reference for Nigerian prospects. Share it only in moderator-approved spaces or inbound content and invite opt-in users; ask an interested, qualified merchant for a refundable reservation. Treat a real reservation as evidence to investigate further; likes and waitlist clicks are not revenue proof. No cold individual DMs. Sources: https://www.kobosync.com/ ; https://www.kobosync.com/legal/terms ; https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/business-to-business-marketing/
red_flags: Desk-check survival does not justify building yet. The Xero review page dates three negative self-reports to 2025-10-09, 2025-03-13, and 2025-03-01; under the stated rule, self-described failures receive zero weight, and the March reports are more than 18 months old as of 2026-10-23. Paystack replied on 2025-04-02 that it had fixed bugs, but that fix is also unverified. The live setup guide is current as of 2026-09-15, so a 12-month release gap is not established. No connector price, paying-user count, install count, or target-market search volume was verified. Treat automation_share_pct 0 as a schema-required sentinel for unmeasured automation, not an estimate that the product would automate nothing. Sources: https://apps.xero.com/za/industry/professional-services/app/paystack ; https://support.paystack.com/en/articles/2127426
